name: Straya Studio Design Tokens
description: Centralized design system for Straya Studio - Premium Light Mode

color._comment: All colors follow Material Design 3 role naming. Light mode only. Never use dark-mode overrides.

primary._comment: Brand black — used for primary buttons, logo, high-emphasis UI

secondary._comment: Straya Green — used for hover states, selection highlights, status indicators

tertiary._comment: Neutral dark — used for tertiary UI elements, muted containers

error._comment: Error states — form validation, destructive actions

background._comment: Surface elevation scale — containerLowest is brightest (white), containerHighest is darkest. Use in order for layered depth.

onBackground._comment: Text/icon colors placed on top of background — DEFAULT for primary text, variant for secondary/supporting text

onSurface._comment: Text/icon colors placed on top of surface containers — disabled for placeholder/inactive states

outline._comment: Border and divider colors — DEFAULT for visible borders, variant for subtle dividers

inverse._comment: Inverse surface for dark-on-light contexts (e.g. tooltips, snackbars). Not used for full dark mode.

status._comment: Semantic status colors — success matches accent (Straya Green)

border._comment: Border tokens — default is near-invisible (5% black), use strong for visible dividers

text._comment: Semantic text aliases — use these in components instead of raw hex values

typography._comment: All font weights are 400 (normal) or 500 (medium). Never use 700 (bold). PP_Mori for display/headings, Instrument Sans for body/UI.

fontFamily._comment: display = PP_Mori for headings and labels. body = Instrument Sans for paragraphs and UI text.

style._comment: tightTracking = -0.04em for headings (tight, cinematic). blueprintTracking = 0.05em for labels/metadata (wide, technical).

h1._comment: Hero headline — fluid clamp, tight tracking, PP_Mori . Used once per page.

h2._comment: Section headings — fluid clamp, tight tracking. Used for major section titles.

h3._comment: Card/subsection headings — fixed size, tight tracking. Used inside cards and bento blocks.

h4._comment: Minor headings — used for feature titles, pricing tier names.

h5._comment: Small headings — used for sidebar titles, accordion headers.

h6._comment: Micro headings — used for metadata labels, table headers.

body._comment: Default body text — paragraphs, descriptions. 1.625 line-height for readability.

bodyLarge._comment: Large body — used for hero descriptions, intro paragraphs.

bodySmall._comment: Small body — used for supporting copy, footnotes, card descriptions.

caption._comment: Caption text — used for image captions, timestamps, helper text.

label._comment: UI labels — used for form labels, nav links, metadata. blueprintTracking (0.05em) + uppercase.

labelUppercase._comment: Uppercase labels — used for section tags, status badges, metric labels. Always uppercase.

labelSmall._comment: Small uppercase labels — used for micro-metadata, version numbers, system status text.

mono._comment: Monospace — used for code snippets, version strings, technical metadata.
mono.fontFamily: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

button._comment: Button text — uppercase, blueprintTracking, medium weight. Used for all CTA and nav buttons.

spacing._comment: All spacing is based on an 8px grid. Section padding uses section-mobile/desktop. Container padding uses containerPaddingMobile/Desktop.

borderOpacity._comment: Tailwind opacity modifier scale for border-black/{value}. e.g. border-black/5 = subtle, border-black/40 = muted text borders.

effects._comment: All motion values. Use transition.base for standard interactions, transition.elastic for luxury feel. depth values require perspective-1k on parent.

transition._comment: entrance = power3.out for all section entrances (LOCKED). base = standard UI interactions. elastic = luxury/premium feel (used on CTAs). smooth = standard Tailwind ease. bouncy = playful (avoid in production).

duration._comment: entrance = section/hero entrances (LOCKED 900ms). fast = micro-interactions. normal = buttons/links/hover. slow = cards/panels. verySlow = page transitions.

stagger._comment: Stagger delays for sequential elements (LOCKED). label=0, heading=80-120ms, body=240ms, cards=360ms+60ms each, cta=last+80ms.

enterFrom._comment: All elements start from this state (LOCKED). Headlines use translateY(100%) inside overflow:hidden for clip reveal.

depth._comment: Z-axis depth for 3D layering. Requires perspective-1k on parent element. 1 = cards, 2 = CTAs, 3 = modals/overlays.

magnetic._comment: Magnetic CTA hover effect — translateZ + scale. Apply .magnetic-cta class to primary buttons.

parallax._comment: Parallax scroll ratios for IMMERSIVE mode sections. background moves slowest, foreground moves at full speed.

grain._comment: SVG fractal noise overlay — always fixed, pointer-events none, z-index 9999. Adds premium texture to light backgrounds.

blur._comment: Backdrop blur values — backdrop used for navbar/modals, surface for cards.

border._comment: Border radius is 0px everywhere (sharp, architectural aesthetic). Only exception is full (9999px) for pills/badges.

width._comment: DEFAULT = standard borders. thin = subtle dividers. thick = emphasis borders.

cursor._comment: Global cursor is crosshair — reinforces the cinematic/technical aesthetic. interactive = pointer for clickable elements.

grid._comment: 4-column baseline grid at 0.06 opacity — used as background overlay in hero and section backgrounds.

animation._comment: All animation values. marquee = platform logos scroll. stagger = delay between sequential element entrances.

marquee._comment: 20s duration per design spec. linear timing for smooth infinite scroll.

zIndex._comment: Z-index scale. grain overlay is 9999 (always on top). navbar is fixed at 50 via Tailwind z-50.

media._comment: Three breakpoints only per GEMINI.md §5.B — sm=390px (mobile), md=810px (tablet), lg=1200px (desktop).

accessibility._comment: WCAG 2.1 AA minimum. All interactive elements must have visible focus states. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

components._comment: Component-level defaults. These are the base values — override via Tailwind utilities in components.

button._comment: All buttons are 0px radius, uppercase, medium weight. Primary uses bg-primary, hover transitions to bg-accent.

card._comment: Cards use surface-container-lowest background, border-black/5 border, 0px radius. Hover lifts translateY(-4px).

input._comment: Form inputs — 0px radius, outline border, 1rem font size. Focus state uses secondary color.

nav._comment: Navbar — fixed, backdrop-blur-xl, bg-background/80, border-b border-black/5.

footer._comment: Footer — bg-surface-container-low, border-t border-black/5, 3rem vertical padding.

layout._comment: Global layout constraints. maxWidth = 1400px centered. Padding scales from mobile to desktop.
